Record Class ElmDocument

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
network.ike.foundation.ike.elm.ElmDocument
Record Components:
library - the root node, of kind Library
public record ElmDocument(ElmDocument.Node library) extends Record
An ELM library as a document, the one shape both readers produce and the exporter writes (IKE-Network/ike-issues#1112). A node is its kind and its members: each member is a position of the kind holding one or more values, a plain value or another node, in document order. Plain values are strings, booleans, or numbers; a qualified type name is written in the braces form, {namespace}local, whichever form it came from. Annotations are never members: the readers drop them.
